description_en: Gets a list of Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) clusters or Serverless Kubernetes (ASK) clusters
description_zh: 获取容器服务K8s集群或Serverless K8s集群列表
name: GetK8sCluster

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return for a paged query. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时当前显示第几页，默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The default value is 1000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示几条，默认值为1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the Kubernetes cluster:

5: an ACK cluster.

7: a self-managed Kubernetes cluster
parameters.help_zh:
K8s集群类型：

5：容器服务K8s集群。
7：自建K8s集群
parameters.name: cluster_type

parameters.help_en:
The subtype of the cluster:

Ask: an ASK cluster.

ManagedKubernetes: an ACK cluster
parameters.help_zh:
集群子类型：
Ask：Serverless K8s 集群。
ManagedKubernetes：容器服务 K8s 集群
parameters.name: sub_cluster_type
